list.query: query_result(sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `api_request` | model =~ ".+" [$__range])))

options.content:
### Activity & Cost — spend, tokens, and latency for api_request
The **stat row** summarises request volume, total and per-request cost, p95 latency, cache efficiency, and output tokens for the current scope. The **breakdown tables** attribute cost across effort, subagent source (`query_source=~agent:.*` are delegated subagents), and model × version (for version-regression triage). The **Prompt Investigation Queue** ranks prompts by cost so you can drill into **Entity Detail** without typing IDs. Raw `api_request` rows live in the collapsed row at the bottom.

_Note: all cost/token/latency fields exist only on `api_request` events. There is no `api_error` event in this build, so reliability is tracked as tool failures on the Tools & Edits dashboard, not here. Log `user_email` is always `unknown`, so there is no User filter._

panels.title: Total Requests

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Count of api_request events in the current scope.

panels.title: Total Cost

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Sum of api_request cost_usd in the current scope (honors the time picker).

panels.title: Avg Cost / Request

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Corrected per-request cost: sum(cost_usd) / count(api_request). NOT an average-of-averages, which would be biased by uneven request batching.

panels.title: P95 Latency

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: 95th percentile api_request duration. With one stream per service, max() collapses multiple services to the worst p95.

panels.title: Cache Hit Efficiency

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: cache_read / (cache_read + input + cache_creation) tokens. Same formula as the Overview canary. A drop means the prompt cache is being underused, inflating cost and latency.

panels.title: Output Tokens

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Sum of api_request output_tokens in the current scope.

panels.title: Requests over Time

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` [$__interval]))

panels.description: api_request volume over the dashboard time picker at $__interval resolution. Use this to see whether cost spikes line up with request bursts.

panels.title: Cost over Time

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cost_usd [$__interval]))

panels.description: Spend trend for the current investigation context at $__interval resolution.

panels.title: Cost & Tokens by Effort

targets.expr: sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | effort =~ ".+" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))
sum by (effort) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | effort =~ ".+" [$__range]))

sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | effort =~ ".+" | unwrap input_tokens [$__range]))

sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | effort =~ ".+" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

panels.description: Cost and token volume grouped by reasoning effort (xhigh/max/high). Use this to see which effort tier dominates spend.

panels.title: Cost by Subagent / Source

targets.expr: sum by (query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | query_source =~ ".+" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

sum by (query_source) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | query_source =~ ".+" [$__range]))

panels.description: Cost attributed by query_source. Rows matching agent:.* are delegated subagents (e.g. agent:builtin:workflow-subagent); repl_main_thread is the main thread; the rest (away_summary, rename_generate_name, etc.) are auxiliary. Group by agent_name as an alternative.

panels.title: Cost & Latency by Model × Version

targets.expr: sum by (model, service_version) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | service_version =~ ".+" [$__range]))

sum by (model, service_version) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | service_version =~ ".+" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

avg by (model, service_version) (avg_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | service_version =~ ".+" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]))

panels.description: Requests, total cost, and average latency split by model and service_version. Use this for version-regression triage: a new version with higher avg latency or cost stands out. Footer sums only the additive Requests/Cost columns, never the average latency.

panels.title: Cache Efficiency over Time

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap input_tokens [$__interval]))
sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__interval]))

panels.description: Cache read vs fresh input vs cache creation tokens, stacked over time. Cache efficiency = cache_read / (cache_read + input + cache_creation): when the cache-read band dominates, the prompt cache is working. A growing input/creation band means cache misses are inflating cost. Plotted as the three summed series since a single-expression ratio is fragile in LogQL.

panels.title: Prompt Investigation Queue

targets.expr: sum by (prompt_id, session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | prompt_id =~ ".+" | unwrap cost_usd [$__range]))

sum by (prompt_id, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | prompt_id =~ ".+" [$__range]))

sum by (prompt_id, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | prompt_id =~ ".+" [$__range]))

sum by (prompt_id, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `false` | prompt_id =~ ".+" [$__range]))

sum by (prompt_id, session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request` | prompt_id =~ ".+" | unwrap output_tokens [$__range]))

panels.description: Prompts ranked by cost, with API/tool volume, tool failures (success=false), and output tokens. Click a Prompt ID to open Entity Detail. The footer sums only additive columns; ratios are intentionally excluded.

panels.title: API Request Detail

targets.expr: {service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | model=~"$model" | event_name = `api_request`

panels.description: Raw api_request rows sorted by Time descending. This single table replaces the old duplicate raw API tables. Columns: Time, model, duration_ms, cost_usd, input/output tokens, effort, query_source, prompt_id, session_id, trace_id.
